description: Assembly source code for a MIPS-based bootloader that handles initialization, relocation, cache management, and transition to the main loader function. It is part of a LZMA compressed kernel loader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards.

methods.name: ehb
methods.description: Macro for executing a hardware barrier instruction.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Main entry point for the bootloader assembly code, performing relocation, cache cleaning, BSS initialization, stack setup, and jumping to the main loader routine.
